_about: Side-car for tools/eval/Recurate.csx. Maps each ev-* question id in data/eval/wizard.v1.jsonl to the canonical OPDB machine title used to look up the actual deployed-Cosmos OPDB id, plus the expected manufacturer partition value (lowercase string matching the deployed catalog's `manufacturer` field — e.g. `stern`, `jjp`, `sega`, `americanpinball`). Out-of-scope rows (acceptable_refusal=true) and the pure-OOS Wizard row have machine_title=null AND expected_manufacturer=null — the recuration script leaves their expected_citation_set as []. The script issues a cross-partition case-insensitive STRINGEQUALS query on c.title (mirrors IMachineRepository.QueryByTitleAsync) and walks the result set picking the first hit whose `manufacturer` matches expected_manufacturer; if no hit matches, the row is skipped with status=mfg_mismatch. The expected_manufacturer column was added 2026-05-08 (Phase 4 W1-3 hardening) after a spot-check of the W1-3 run revealed the 3 Godzilla questions (intended for Stern's 2021 Godzilla) silently resolved to Sega's 1998 Godzilla because `STRINGEQUALS('Godzilla')` first-hit returned the older record while the modern Stern catalog is currently absent from the deployed Cosmos. expected_manufacturer values are curated from each question's text + the row's `notes` field in data/eval/wizard.v1.jsonl. Commit alongside the recuration PR so a future audit can trace why a given question maps to a given title and manufacturer.
